description: Check whether a phone number has an active WhatsApp account (without sending any message or OTP), including whether it is a WhatsApp Business account. Also returns phone enrichment (carrier, line type, country). Costs 1 WA credit per successful call. Response fields: numberstatus (true = on WhatsApp), businessnumber (true = business account).

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country hint when phone_number is in local format.

phone_number.description: Phone number to check, in E.164 (+14155552671) or local format.

name: check_whatsapp
